prompts.build: Build the home page for Hollis Estate Planning, a legal business in Cedar Point, NC. It needs a call to action ("Schedule a consultation" linking to /contact/) with a click-to-call button, a row with these credentials: Board-certified estate planner, Flat-fee wills and trusts, Home and hospital visits, Plain-language documents, the contact details (phone, email, address, hours), and a closing call to action. Use the site's existing business details. Save it as a published page.
prompts.edit: The business phone number is now (555) 555-0155. Update the site so every place that shows or dials the phone uses the new number.

build.result:

- Credentials row: Board-certified estate planner, Flat-fee wills and trusts, Home and hospital visits, Plain-language documents
- Contact details row: phone, email, address (135 Main Street, Cedar Point, NC 27502), hours (Mon–Fri, 8am–5pm)
- Closing CTA with the same consultation + call buttons

All business details pulled from the site's existing business-details record.
